quote: The hotspot and smoke haze situation may improve over areas with showers, with a reduced risk of transboundary haze occurrence.
outlook_text: Over the next few days, parts of the southern ASEAN region are forecast to remain dry, except over Peninsular Malaysia, Sumatra, as well as parts of Java and Borneo where there are likely to be showers. The hotspot and smoke haze situation may improve over areas with showers, with a reduced risk of transboundary haze occurrence. However, hotspot with smoke plumes can still occur over areas experiencing prolonged dry weather. The prevailing winds over the southern ASEAN region are expected to blow mainly from the east to southeast. Showers are forecast over the northern ASEAN region, except for relatively drier conditions over parts of northern and eastern Mekong sub-region. Isolated hotspots and smoke plumes may develop over areas experiencing prolonged dry conditions. The prevailing winds over the northern ASEAN region are likely to blow from the northeast to east, apart from the northern and western parts of Mekong sub-region where the winds are expected to be light and variable in direction.
